name: integrated-agent-workflow
description: Coordinate native agents and authorized child chats with inherited task context under HQ, plus optional read-only CLI advisers.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate agents and manager chats under HQ.
interface.longDescription: Use native sub-agents in one chat by default. With explicit task-creation authorization, split independent work into Astra/Sol manager chats supervising task-fit Terra/Luna/Spark workers with explicit skill/data handoffs while HQ owns integration and final validation. Prefer completed-history forks where useful; Astra defaults to xhigh and Sol/Luna to high when the active tool permits. Optional external CLI and LM Studio advisers remain read-only, and model availability follows each active tool schema.
defaultPrompt: Run a multi-agent review of this change.
Coordinate Astra, Sol, Terra, and Luna sub-agents by task fit.
Keep this Astra chat as HQ and create Sol child chats when independent work benefits, passing the current task, required skills and data to each manager.
Use gpt-5.3-codex-spark for a focused fast subtask.
Check which configured reviewer models are available.
